findings: If sqlite3.connect() itself fails, the book's code raises NameError in finally (and in the rollback), because connection was never assigned; a warning gives the fix (connection = None before try).

The text describes handling several exception types without an example; an added example, which also answers the class activity, catches ValueError and ZeroDivisionError. Check questions and their answers were written for the lesson and need the second-person review.
